description: A list sum follows pushes and pops
code:
scores = [4, 6]
total = scores.sum()
scores.push(10)
assert(total, 20)
scores.pop()
total

description: A selector sums a property over every instance of a class
code:
class Order(amount):
    this.amount = amount
Order(20)
Order(15)
revenue = Order.sum(order -> order.amount)
Order(5)
revenue

description: Summing an empty list or a class without instances gives zero
Summed values convert to numbers so booleans count and numeric strings add
code:
votes = [true, false, true, true]
amounts = ["2", 3, null]
[votes.sum(), amounts.sum()]

description: A class-level rule sums the lines of each order
code:
class Order(name):
    this.name = name
class Line(order, cost):
    this.order = order
    this.cost = cost
$Order.total = Line.filter(line -> line.order == $Order).sum(line -> line.cost)
north = Order("north")
Line(north, 4)
Line(north, 6)
north.total

description: A filtered sum totals only the matching items and stays live
code:
expenses = [12, 40, 7, 55]
large = expenses.filter(amount -> amount > 20).sum()
expenses.push(30)
large

description: A missing property keeps a population sum unknown until it is set
code:
class Item
pen = Item()
pen.price = 3
book = Item()
spent = Item.sum(item -> item.price)
assert(spent, null)
book.price = 12
spent

description: A sum selector that is not a function raises a TypeError
code:
failure = ""
try:
    [1, 2].sum(5)
catch error:
    failure = error
failure
